applicability_and_side_effects: Projection loss checks image coordinates, not visibility or 3D physical validity. Support uses evaluated mesh world AABBs and cannot prove contact or intersection; unknown is not absence of support. Parent links do not prove geometry connectivity. Material creation adds Blender datablocks and requires assignment; this test used procedural object coordinates with no image resource. Diagnostics do not move objects. Whole assemblies must be distinguished from their parts before repair; a stationary pivot alone does not establish an intact hinge/frame/opening relation.
